Maya (PM): quick sync — UX pass on the playground streaming UI. uploaded new frames + short recording: https://img.redwood.dev/s/stream-pass.mp4 Jon (Design): watching now. what are the main tradeoffs we're deciding? Maya (PM): 3 axis: button topology (single vs dual), token counter behavior during partial streams, and keyboard affordances (Esc vs custom). also accessibility announcements. Jon (Design): my vote: single prominent primary 'Stop & Regenerate' while streaming, because users often want to iterate. when idle, show separate 'Regenerate' and 'Stop' states to avoid accidental regen. Ravi (Eng): single primary is fine. main implementation notes: snapshot token_count on stop, and expose a small "paused at N tokens" microcopy. avoid speculative counting since it confuses billing. Ava (UX): agree. accessibility: ensure the final fragment is announced and doesn't re-announce earlier partial chunks. use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" on the final wrapper. Ravi (Eng): snippet we can use: ```
Response complete — 98 tokens
``` Jon (Design): microcopy: prefer 'Response complete — draft saved' over 'stopped' to reduce anxiety about losing work. Maya (PM): that phrasing is good. also let's make token tooltip explicit: "Preview tokens shown here. Final billing may differ after regen." Ava (UX): keyboard: users asked for Esc to stop in feedback. We already use Esc to dismiss composer. proposal: composer-scoped Esc stops stream; global Esc closes the panel. add tiny inline hint when streaming: "Esc to stop". Ravi (Eng): can implement composer-only handler. caveat: ensure focus management doesn't swallow Esc for other controls. Jon (Design): small-screen behavior: narrow devices should collapse to a single small 'Stop' pill + overflow menu with regen action. reduces layout jank. Maya (PM): decision summary: primary UI = single 'Stop & Regenerate' on desktop during streaming, freeze token counter at last emitted value, show faded "paused at N tokens" state, composer-scoped Esc stops stream, aria-live polite+atomic + aria-label on button, prompt library insert disabled while streaming. redwood-bot: created checklist. redwood-bot: checklist created: [single primary btn, freeze token counter, paused microcopy, composer-scoped Esc, aria-atomic, disable prompt inserts]. Ava (UX): I'll write three microcopy variations (friendly/formal/compact) and post for pick. Ravi (Eng): i'll open a small PR for aria attributes + token snapshot and add tests for screen reader announcement. ETA tomorrow AM. Jon (Design): updating frames with small-screen collapse behavior and tooltip copy. will share updated prototype by EOD. Maya (PM): great work. leaving thread open for extra nits — shout if anything blocks implementation. :rocket:
